name: Misshitsu no Shoujo ~Suki ni Shite Ii yo~
original_name: 密室の少女～好きにしていいよ～
source:
"You can do anything you want to me until morning" - such an e-mail arrived on Eiichi's inbox.

Suspicious but curious, the protagonist went to the address written in the e-mail. Contrary to his expectations, there laid a single girl.

In this dark room, unable to reject her invitations, he soon came to give in to his sexual desires.
translation:
“直到早上为止，你想对我做什么都可以。”一封这样的邮件出现在英一的收件箱中。

主角虽感到可疑，却又按捺不住好奇心，前往邮件中写下的地址。出乎预料的是，那里只有一个女孩。

在这间昏暗的房间里，他无法拒绝女孩的邀请，很快便屈服于自己的性欲。
